discoveryQuery.observed: The query for an absent cloud-kitchen button retried for minutes and exhausted the 300-second test allowance.
discoveryQuery.change: Resolve the footer from the active presentation; the regular-width ingredient chooser has live results and no fixed result button.

largeTextScroll.observed: The maximum-text recording showed the decide button partially behind the fixed result action after full swipes repeatedly jumped past it. The original helper passed in two local audit runs, so the CI failure was intermittent.
largeTextScroll.change: Measure the control overlap with the visible chooser viewport, drag only that distance with a held release, and require the entire frame to be hittable. Capture the viewport and hierarchy on failure.

scopedQueries.observed: Both recordings showed the expected visible state: an enabled decide action and a restored 877-recipe list after clearing the goal. Global button queries took seconds and the state predicates expired.
scopedQueries.change: Resolve the unique decide button with firstMatch; scope the result goal query to navigation bars. Keep state and spoken-name assertions and capture hierarchy and screen for either readiness or goal-value failures.

kitchenSelection.observed: The recording showed the egg selected and the selection count updated to two after the 3D tap. The text-only button query still timed out waiting for selection. The same baseline passed locally.
kitchenSelection.change: Assert selection through the active kitchen basket identifier instead of shared ingredient text, preserving the 3D tap, selected state, count and cross-presentation checks. Capture hierarchy and screenshot on failure.

decisionDismissal.observed: The recording showed the recipe detail for 燕麦鸡蛋饼 after opening the settled card. The predicate waiting for the old decide action to disappear timed out.
decisionDismissal.change: Wait for the recipe-detail action to appear, then use the native waitForNonExistence API to check that the decision action is gone. Keep diagnostics and both navigation assertions.

selectionWait.observed: The fresh accessibility hierarchy contained exactly one Button labelled 番茄, marked Selected, matching the screenshot. The predicate waiting for isSelected still timed out after 30 seconds. The baseline passed locally.
selectionWait.change: Use the native key-path property waiter for positive and negative selection checks, preserving the timeout and failure diagnostics. Use the same native property wait for the kitchen basket selection.

pickerPreparation.observed: Broader local testing exposed partial search text and filter rows that remained below the visible medium sheet. Short content drags repeatedly returned to medium without bringing the row into view.
pickerPreparation.change: Expand a medium filter sheet through its native toolbar before scrolling to hidden options. Scope drags to the unobscured content and require the entire target row to be visible. Reuse this helper for pantry and avoid entries; wait for complete search text before asserting the unchanged input value.

sixthFollowUp.observed: Both the screenshot and fresh accessibility hierarchy showed the 番茄炒蛋 result row. The global first-match query timed out waiting for existence. The local full main class had passed on both devices.

visibleRow.label: 番茄炒蛋、炒锅 · 普通

sixthFollowUp.change: Scope ingredient queries to the chooser collection and initial recipe queries to the result collection, retaining spoken-label matching. Use native existence, selection, enabled and hittable wait APIs for simple states; composite waits share the original 30-second deadline and recheck both states. Keep predicates for text/value conditions and all failure diagnostics.

relatedPhoneFailure.observed: The maximum-text recording showed 土豆 selected with a checkmark while the generic isSelected predicate timed out.
relatedPhoneFailure.change: The four repeated wait helpers now delegate boolean states to the common native waiter; affected dietary checks and decision readiness reuse it too.

sharedWaitHelper.behavior: Native polling for boolean attributes; compound states keep one original deadline and poll until both states match. Text/value predicates and geometric/animation predicates retain their existing checks. Every shared-wait failure captures the current accessibility hierarchy and screen.
sharedWaitHelper.validation: Both complete 12-case main classes passed before extraction. Final targeted runs cover cloud-kitchen large text, history/account, discovery, random recipes, dietary goals and all three compound state combinations; CI orchestration checks passed 10/10.

decisionDismissal.observed: The detail action appeared, but the retained global query for the destroyed decision button timed out while evaluating snapshots.
decisionDismissal.change: Check the decision navigation title before opening, then use a fresh navigation-bar query for its disappearance and retain the positive detail assertion.

clearedGoal.observed: The captured accessibility tree contained the expected results.options label 更多选项，饮食目标：不限目标 while the compound value/label predicate timed out.
clearedGoal.change: Use the native exact label property waiter and fresh navigation-button queries after goal/filter dismissal.

contributionForm.observed: The contribution test exceeded 300 seconds. Local scoped input queries fixed scrolling/typing; a fresh-host control still reproduced repeated 60-second App animations complete notification not received waits after typing.
contributionForm.change: Query native input roles inside the form, reveal controls above the keyboard with measured drags, and disable UIKit animations only for the three functional feedback cases through a Debug ui-testing launch flag. Preserve all submission and retained-draft assertions.
contributionForm.discardedExperiment: Separate simulator/test-host invocations did not prevent the animation wait; no additional form invocations or retries were added to CI.

seventhFollowUp.localInfrastructure: A local simulator touch-synthesis stall exceeded two hours before the animation experiment. Subsequent local commands used an owned 20-minute process-group watchdog and caffeinate; these guards are temporary local tooling, not CI retries.

eighthFollowUp.observed: The other five iOS groups passed. Both iPad accessibility audits passed. One regular dietary case failed while waiting for the destroyed dietary.done button through a fresh navigationBars.buttons query. At 55 seconds the recording shows the goal picker already dismissed, with the parent 筛选 sheet and the selected 减少添加糖 row visible.
eighthFollowUp.change: Scope completion actions to their named navigation bar, then assert that the dismissed goal/filter navigation bar disappears using a fresh query. Keep the dismissal assertion and all selected-goal, visible-result and persistence checks.

missingElementTraversal.observed: The same first dietary regression case timed out resolving a missing navigation bar. The recording at 50 seconds again shows the goal picker closed and its parent filter sheet active. Both audits and the other five regular dietary cases passed.
missingElementTraversal.diagnostic: The earlier spindump sampled XCTElementQuery._firstMatchingSnapshotForInput -> XCTFilteringTransformerIterator.nextMatch -> XCTElementSnapshotDescendantsEnumerator.nextObject -> XCElementSnapshot.children on the App main thread. This supports exhaustive missing-element traversal as the cause; changing the missing element type did not solve it.
missingElementTraversal.change: Verify dismissal by requiring the actual presenting page control to exist and become hittable, then interact with that page. Use explicit known origins instead of probing for an optional absent results toolbar. Preserve selected goals, picker-until-done, saved settings, visible recipes and ingredient assertions.

kitchenQueryScope.observed: A global navigation-bar enumeration and global zero-WebView count took tens of seconds before the pot event synthesis timed out. The other 19 discovery cases passed.
kitchenQueryScope.change: Identify the native kitchen content List, scope its projected buttons and zero-WebView assertion to that container, use the known Find Recipes navigation bar, and choose the footer from the active presentation instead of probing an absent one. Keep the actual projected taps, native-rendering check, selection and recipe navigation assertions.

tenthFollowUp.orchestrationValidation: Final node --test test/iosTestInfrastructure.test.mjs passed 10/10; all 54 UI methods remain assigned exactly once per device, without adding UI assertion retries.

eleventhFollowUp.observed: Both dietary groups passed. Nineteen of twenty iPad discovery scenarios passed, including rotation and reviewed-recipe navigation. The largest-text menu scenario failed looking for its quick-list option immediately after two edge-touch open/current-selection/close checks. Recording and failure hierarchy show the Find Recipes page with no presented menu.
eleventhFollowUp.inference: CookPresentationToggle.updateUIView recreated the UIButton menu and icon on every SwiftUI update, even without a selection or accessibility-subtitle change. Replacing presentation objects during unrelated updates can interfere with the native menu lifecycle.
eleventhFollowUp.change: Keep the existing native menu and actions for unchanged selection/subtitle configuration. Rebuild the menu and icon when that configuration changes; action callbacks still read the coordinator’s current binding. Preserve every UI menu, 44pt edge-hit, selected-state and largest-text assertion.
eleventhFollowUp.regressionProof: Two focused unit tests cover menu/action identity across unrelated refreshes and selected-state/subtitle changes. Before the guard, the identity case failed both identity assertions while the state-transition case passed. With the guard, both passed.
eleventhFollowUp.baselineDiagnostics: The expected-failure unit run finished its assertions; its owned simctl diagnostic collector was terminated after collection stalled. xcodebuild finalized with status 65. No running tests were interrupted.

compatibilityHitArea.observed: On iOS 26.5 the custom UIButton reported a 44pt frame but its SwiftUI toolbar parents were only 36pt high. The first upper-edge tap failed before any menu selection. A fixed 44pt frame alone did not change the clipped parent. Removing the shared capsule for the quick-list toolbar made both edge taps pass; the corresponding kitchen toolbar then exposed the same clipping.
compatibilityHitArea.change: Use one CookPresentationToolbarItem for both presentations. Give the custom item its own 44pt glass capsule on iOS 26+, outside the system shared toolbar capsule; keep the UIKit native menu and standard older-system path.
experiments: stable-menu-compat: 3/4 passed; largest-text first quick-list edge tap failed
stable-menu-frame-compat: 3/4 passed; explicit frame alone kept the 36pt parent and failed the same edge tap
stable-menu-toolbar-compat: 3/4 passed; both quick-list edges passed, then the unchanged kitchen parent failed its first edge tap

eleventhFollowUp.completeRunResult: Swift and five of six native groups passed. Only the iPad discovery group failed, with 19/20 scenarios passing and the maximum-text menu lookup failing. Both main groups completed successfully.
eleventhFollowUp.finalLocalValidation: The shared native toolbar and cached menu passed 8/8 on iPadOS 27 and 4/4 on iOS 26.5. Existing UI assertions, edge taps and gesture checks were retained.

twelfthFollowUp.completedGroups: Swift and all five other native groups passed, including all twenty iPad discovery cases and both complete main groups with the new menu tests.

firstAttempt.observed: Both iPad accessibility audit cases passed. Before any regular dietary case started, CookUITests-Runner exited while bootstrapping at XCTWaiter(StallHandling) handleStalledWait. The result bundle contained only the synthetic runner failure for this invocation.
firstAttempt.recovery: One failed-group rerun was requested after all other groups completed; successful jobs were retained. No UI assertion was retried automatically.

secondAttempt.observed: The runner started successfully. Both audits and five regular cases passed. The empty-goal cancellation case crossed its 300-second allowance while continuing through its original interactions; it reached teardown at 360 seconds without a reported assertion failure. This timeout was treated as a real failure and was not rerun unchanged.
secondAttempt.trace: The first global cook.filters tap began at 31.98s, resolved its button at 59.85s and synthesized at 68.07s. Goal selection and parent-control checks took over 200 seconds before the ingredient was selected. The later reveal helper queried identical window/list frames repeatedly.

twelfthFollowUp.change: Resolve Find Recipes toolbar buttons inside the known navigation bar, goal options inside their choices list and recipe rows inside their result list. Reuse one window frame per reveal call and one chooser frame per iteration while recalculating the actual viewport after scrolling. Apply existing App teardown to dietary fixtures. Preserve all goal, ingredient, native selection, full-visibility and dismissal assertions; keep 300 seconds for other regular cases and use an explicit 600-second ceiling for the two multi-page/relaunch journeys. The empty-goal trace reached its last checks at 360 seconds; the saved-goal journey took 263.821 seconds and contains multiple App relaunches. Every individual assertion still retains its existing wait deadline, and timeouts remain failures.
twelfthFollowUp.orchestrationValidation: node --test test/iosTestInfrastructure.test.mjs passed 10/10; all 54 UI methods remain assigned exactly once per device. No assertion or case retry was added.

thirteenthFollowUp.observed: All six CloudKitchen cases and the other thirteen iPad discovery/random cases passed. Empty-scene cancellation failed while resolving its first ingredient before any ingredient tap. Its global label-matching button query performed two internal XCTest retries before snapshot evaluation failed at 247.90 seconds.
thirteenthFollowUp.change: Bound ingredient labels, inspiration controls and context to the active cooking List; scene and goal-entry buttons to filter.options; menu/filter toolbar controls to the Find Recipes navigation bar; detail favorite queries to navigation bars. Cache the window frame and each iteration’s existence result, and use the known navigation bar for Find Recipes/filter scrolling. Apply the same initial chooser ingredient and toolbar bounds in CloudKitchen. Keep projected virtual scene identifiers globally unique as required by their changing snapshot ancestry. All existing navigation, selection, full-visibility, camera and preserved-filter assertions remain.
thirteenthFollowUp.localSetup: An initial local class run was interrupted to correct the favorite-toolbar locator before continuing. It is not counted as a passing class run.

dietaryPresentation.observed: Both accessibility audits, empty-goal cancellation and goal persistence passed. The browsing journey lost its snapshot connection while querying dietary.openPicker inside filter.options immediately after reopening the filter sheet from the returned Find Recipes page. The recording shows the filter sheet visibly presented and retained until cleanup; the evidence does not establish a normal App crash.
dietaryPresentation.change: Require the presented filter navigation to exist and be hittable, then require its List before looking for the goal row. Share this presentation guard between opening the picker and verifying the current value. Apply the corresponding navigation/List readiness checks to goal sheets opened from filters and results. This adds state assertions without retries or relaxed per-operation deadlines.
dietaryPresentation.inspection: Downloaded only the result metadata and the failing recording using verified ZIP member checksums after the full archive transfer stalled. Reclaim this partial extraction after final validation.

thirteenthFollowUp.relatedLabelAssertion: Apply the same known chooser scope to the main cooking-flow VoiceOver label query; keep exact spoken-name matching and native selection assertions. No ingredient-label predicate remains global in these cooking flows.
thirteenthFollowUp.orchestrationValidation: Final script replay passed 10/10. UI method names and group assignments are unchanged; no UI case or assertion retry was added.

phoneCompletion.cloudJourney: The shared-selection/real-recipes journey reached its final back navigation at 299.88 seconds, then crossed the 300-second allowance while still progressing. It now has an explicit 600-second ceiling, with all workflow assertions retained.
phoneCompletion.footerSnapshot: The maximum-text audit completed its accessibility categories, then failed while reading the global cook.showResults frame during scrolling. Require the fixed footer to exist and, when enabled, become hittable, validate its visible geometry, and read its fixed frame once per reveal call. Empty-result states retain the visible-but-disabled footer and their disabled-state assertion.
phoneCompletion.goalSnapshot: The standalone-results goal-clear case failed while looking for its none option immediately after opening the goal sheet. The shared goal-sheet navigation/List readiness guard covers this path as well.

thirteenthFollowUp.finalLocalValidation: Complete discovery class passed 11/11 on iPad. Discovery plus affected CloudKitchen cases passed 12 with three pre-existing iPad-only skips on iPhone. Four changed CloudKitchen chooser journeys passed on iPad. Main cooking-flow label cases passed on both devices. Reopened-sheet cases passed on both devices; the largest-text iPhone audit and final enabled/disabled-footer journeys passed. Final orchestration replay passed 10/10.
